test_cases.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want to choose Affirm for a new customer's phone and get to the send-link step, so that the phone's full price with tax is what goes to Affirm
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
This test checks the main path: one phone, no accessories, financed with Affirm up to the last window before a link would be sent, which is closed without sending. In a Metro by T-Mobile store, a rep (the dealer's employee at the counter) sells phones, opens new phone lines and sells accessories such as speakers and phone grips. A new-customer sale (activation) gives a new customer a phone, a SIM card and a monthly plan. After the accessories step the store app offers to let the customer pay over time. One way is Affirm, a lending company: the rep picks the items to spread out, Affirm sends the customer a link by email and text, and the customer applies on their own phone. The picked items must total at least $50.00 including tax, and accessories may add at most $150.00 before tax. SmartPay (lease-to-own) is offered beside Affirm when the sale has a phone.

Words used in this test:
- IMEI: the phone's serial number.
- ICCID: the SIM card's serial number.
- Cart: the panel on the right of the screen that lists everything in the sale and the totals.
- Banner: a strip of text with a button that appears above the Cart's Continue button.
- PP Tax: Prepaid Tax, a tax shown separately from sales tax. The Cart shows the sale's total PP Tax on its own line.
- MRC: the monthly charge for the plan.
- MAU55, MAU55AAL, COUP_NEUVQ4, NYMCP10 and similar: plan, promotion and protection names exactly as the screen shows them.
- NPA NXX: the area code and the first three digits of the new phone number.
- TALK TRACK: suggested words for the rep to say to the customer.
- UAT2: a test environment of the store app. User settings must show Environment UAT2.
- EZLOGIC: the test store.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2037 (Affirm checkout), RTPL-3256 (Affirm parity list), RTPL-3401 (SmartPay beside Affirm)

## Preconditions
- The rep has a sign-in for store EZLOGIC on UAT2 (from the team; never written in a ticket).
- No sale is open on this till. If one is left from an earlier run, cancel it first: Cancel in the Cart, then Cancel cart, then Yes, cancel transaction.
- The phones and SIMs in the test data have not been used by a submitted order.

## Test data
- **Store:** Store EZLOGIC, dealer code 30247306  _(verified: seen on UAT2 from 2026-11-12, in the page header after sign-in)_
- **New customer:** First name AFFIRM, last name TESTER; email: a brand-new made-up address each run, for example affirm.qa.<today's date and time>@example.com; address 405 LEXINGTON AVE, zip code 10174, city NEW YORK; PIN 628193; any three different security questions from the lists, with any answers  _(verified: seen on UAT2 on 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17 in new-customer sales (account created, ID verification skipped); address and PIN also accepted on UAT2 on 2026-10-23)_
- **Phone, line 1:** IMEI 999977128538057 (Samsung A16, item SAM A166U A16 5G 128G BLU KIT, row 60 of the UAT2_Devices tab in the RTGO Data workbook); price $189.99, tax $20.90, line amount $210.89  _(verified: seen on UAT2 on 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17 in new-customer sales, accepted at IMEI validation both days)_
- **SIM, line 1:** ICCID 8901260000073716997F (row 153 of the UAT2_SIMS tab)  _(verified: seen on UAT2 on 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17 in new-customer sales, accepted both days)_
- **Number area:** Service area zip code 10174, then the number group (347) 499  _(verified: seen on UAT2 on 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17 in new-customer sales)_
- **Customer mobile:** 2125550123 (made up; typed only into the contact window, never sent)  _(verified: seen on UAT2 on 2026-11-16 in a one-phone new-customer sale, and seen on UAT2 on 2026-11-12 in bill payments with an accessory)_

## Screens (design reference)
- **Pay-over-time options (bill-payment version: it shows only the Affirm card; in this test SmartPay is shown too)** — screenshot: `walk/screens/w1-09-pay-over-time-options.jpg` (attach from the run folder)
- **Finance Items (taken in a bill payment; same screen)** — screenshot: `walk/screens/w1-14-finance-items.jpg` (attach from the run folder)
- **Affirm Cart & Agreement window (taken in a bill payment; same screen)** — screenshot: `walk/screens/w1-15-send-window.jpg` (attach from the run folder)

## Automation Notes
- Money check: the amount that goes to Affirm is the phone's price plus its tax ($189.99 + $20.90 = $210.89). Select Items must never list the plan, the SIM card or the fees.
- The card with Accessories $0.00 and Available balance $150.00 shows that the phone does not use up the $150.00 accessory allowance.
- The offer does not open by itself after Continue: the banner appears and the rep opens the offer with Get started here. This is the behaviour checked here.
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: in the November new-customer sales the Affirm Application window opened when Continue was clicked on Select Items; in the older bill payments it opened together with Select Items. If it opens at a different moment, report it to the manual QA team.
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: step(s) 33 (changing the email) and 38 (closing the window with the X) were seen on the same screens in a bill payment with an accessory (UAT2, 2026-11-12), not yet in a new-customer sale. Check the wording on the first run.
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: every value was checked on UAT2, the environment chosen for this feature. After signing in, open the user menu and check that User settings shows Environment UAT2: signing in has been seen to change it.
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: the live walks recorded the screen reached after each group of clicks. Where an expected result only says that a choice is marked, a box shows a value or a list closes, that single click was not recorded on its own. The ID-skip window text was recorded on 2026-11-13.
- If a phone or SIM in the test data is refused when you run this (for example Sim card active or used), try the next unused row of the same tab in the RTGO Data workbook. If none work, or a screen differs from this ticket, contact the manual QA team to help get working data - do not sit blocked and do not hunt for data alone.

Whether the same phone and SIM are accepted again after the rep cancels a sale has not been tried; after the system cancelled a sale they were accepted again.

test_cases.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
This test checks that choosing pay in full only closes the offer window and leaves the rep on the accessories screen. In a Metro by T-Mobile store, a rep (the dealer's employee at the counter) sells phones, opens new phone lines and sells accessories such as speakers and phone grips. A new-customer sale (activation) gives a new customer a phone, a SIM card and a monthly plan. After the accessories step the store app offers to let the customer pay over time. One way is Affirm, a lending company: the rep picks the items to spread out, Affirm sends the customer a link by email and text, and the customer applies on their own phone. The picked items must total at least $50.00 including tax, and accessories may add at most $150.00 before tax. SmartPay (lease-to-own) is offered beside Affirm when the sale has a phone.

Words used in this test:
- IMEI: the phone's serial number.
- ICCID: the SIM card's serial number.
- Cart: the panel on the right of the screen that lists everything in the sale and the totals.
- Banner: a strip of text with a button that appears above the Cart's Continue button.
- PP Tax: Prepaid Tax, a tax shown separately from sales tax. The Cart shows the sale's total PP Tax on its own line.
- MRC: the monthly charge for the plan.
- MAU55, MAU55AAL, COUP_NEUVQ4, NYMCP10 and similar: plan, promotion and protection names exactly as the screen shows them.
- NPA NXX: the area code and the first three digits of the new phone number.
- TALK TRACK: suggested words for the rep to say to the customer.
- UAT2: a test environment of the store app. User settings must show Environment UAT2.
- EZLOGIC: the test store.
